title: Run Console
description: Operator-facing console for a real-looking local experiment run. It resolves the image path, opens the run folder, queues workers, records command output, and returns the final artifacts.

messages.text: Start run from workspace/Craft_Utopia/tiantan.png. Target: build the visible Tiantan structure in Minecraft with six builder agents and write generated files under workspace/Craft_Utopia/runs/tiantan_build_001.
Input resolved. I created the run directory, saved compact run_config.json, and pinned the image checksum before starting vision.
vision-blueprint: inspect the reference image, run reconstruction, and export placements.jsonl plus a short uncertainty report. Do not hand-edit a template.
Vision worker finished. It wrote mesh.obj, stage_preview.schem, placements.jsonl, and uncertain_edges.json for the roof lip and entrance trim.
messages.systemLog: INFO job=vision-blueprint-0 exit=0 duration=14.58s placements=9274 palette=18 uncertain=23 log=logs/vision-blueprint.log

messages.text: planner: split placements into non-overlapping worker jobs. Keep x=0 locked until both sides report their roof checkpoints.
Planner wrote west.json, east.json, locks.json, checkpoints.json, and the retry policy. Build workers are ready to connect to the local server.
messages.systemLog: planner INFO chunks=2 worker_jobs=6 locked_columns=1 checkpoints=7 server=127.0.0.1:25565

messages.text: Build phase finished with one local roof-row correction and two temporary scaffold sets. The merge step wrote world/merged_state.json.
messages.systemLog: merge INFO west=4821 east=4453 skipped=0 corrected=7 temporary=31 out=world/merged_state.json

messages.text: verify: compare the merged world with placements.jsonl, apply only whitelisted entrance fixes, remove tagged scaffolds, and package the replay logs.
Run complete. Final outputs are final_world.schem, report.json, replay.jsonl, and a tarball with the raw worker logs.
